title: Classy Curtain
text: Classy Curtain. Classy shower curtain at a great price point, reminds me of an upscale hotel shower curtain. Arrived quickly and though it has a few wrinkles, I'm sure hanging in the bathroom it will smooth out after a few showers. Or I could get ambitious and iron it...nah

product_metadata.title: instecho Fabric 3-in-1 Shower Curtain Set with PEVA Snap-in Liner and Window, 71-Inch by 74-inch, White/Brown
features: 3-in-1 shower curtain set includes fabric shower curtain, FLEX-ON built-in rings, PEVA replacement liner and window
100% polyester shower curtain with water-resistant It’s A Snap! Snap-In PEVA Liner
Installs in seconds without removing the rod
FLEX-ON built-in rings included so no separate hooks to buy
It's a Snap! PEVA liner repels water and snaps on and stays on; Includes sheer top window that lets light in, reduces humidity all while protecting your privacy
description: Brings that spa-like experience to your bathroom with the original, patented Hookless Shower Curtain Set. The patented Hookless Shower Curtain Set offers a 3-in-1 value and adds an unexpected way to refresh your bathroom décor effortlessly in seconds. With no hooks to buy, you will save money while saving time with the convenience of a shower curtain that slides right onto your hanging shower curtain rod, installing in seconds with no need to remove the rod. The patented plastic FLEX-ON rings will never rust, and the It’s A Snap! liner literally snaps on and off, so you can change it in seconds. The attached PEVA liner is eco-friendly, PVC-free liner repels water making for easy care and maintenance. A sheer window lets light in, maintains privacy, and reduces humidity and moisture.
